explanation: One of Joseph's sons and the ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes, often used as a symbol for all Israel.
The patriarch of Israel's twelve tribes, also known as Israel after God changed his name. He was the son of Isaac and the grandson of Abraham.
Another name for God, used to show respect and reverence.
A person who receives messages from God and conveys them to the people. Hosea was such a prophet.
The historical region in the Middle East that includes parts of present-day Israel, Palestine, Lebanon, and Syria. This area was promised by God to Abraham's descendants.
An evil or unjust act, often committed against God's will.
The principle of acting rightly and morally, in accordance with God's will and commands.
To repent or turn away from sin and injustice, and seek God's grace and forgiveness.
